pages.text: Dad was going out to sea the next morning. This time, they would go with him.
They wanted to ride Dad's boat out to sea. "We are really going to the middle of the sea!"
Riri opened her bag wide. Lolo was already outside. "Pack what we need first." "Get there early and wait."
A blanket, a water bottle, and bread went neatly into the bag. A towel and shells went in too.
The bag grew bigger than Riri. She struggled underneath it.
At dawn, Lolo followed Dad to the boat, then sat by the side, waiting for sunrise.
The sun rose, but Lolo was fast asleep, not even noticing that one boot had slipped off.
Dad shook Lolo awake. Riri arrived too, dragging her bag.
Dad put life jackets on both of them. Putt, putt, putt, the boat headed out to sea.
They were in the middle of the sea. A flock of seagulls followed close behind their boat. "Seagulls follow our boat too!" they shouted.
